related.name: Kshitij G.
related.text:
Quite a few things actually might look miniscule but at the same time enlightening:
The contrast between incident vs story beautiful explained with a daily routine example
The importance of theme, well defined goal as well as rising conflicts / stakes to make an engaging story
References to movies like pursuit of happyness, munna bhai, the whole story arc on godfather were quite insightful info
related.label: Screenwriting Workshop
related.note: Mentions The Godfather story arc; Nelson calls Godfather a bible in his episode 6.

related.name: Moulali K.
related.text: Being a film making aspiring I have attended this workshop without any expectations. But finally it turned out as a major learning source of multiple dimensions of the film direction and script building. I would say full paisa vasool guys. Vizil podu..
